name: Ba Den Mountain
kicker: Peak and cable lines over the plain
summary: Ba Den, the 986 m peak: ride the summit cable and the temple line, and give it most of a day. The gate fee covers entry only. Vân Sơn is 450,000 VND for an adult through 31 December 2026, and 300,000 VND after 17:00. Leave when weather has stopped the cabins.
fee: 450,000 VND for an adult on Vân Sơn
getThere: A little more than 10 km, or 11 km northeast, from the city, in phường Bình Minh.
heroCaption: A cable cabin over the forest, with the plain beyond

notice.title: The gate ticket leaves the cable unpaid
notice.body: An adult gate ticket is 10,000 VND. The Vân Sơn line to the summit is 450,000 VND through 31 December 2026. Chùa Hang and Tâm An are separate lines.

body: Pay the gate at khu phố Ninh Phú, then ride from Ba Den Station. Vân Sơn goes to the summit at 986 m. Chùa Hang goes to the Black Lady temple cluster, Linh Sơn Tiên Thạch. Tâm An is a third line and does not run Monday to Friday. One line is the shorter visit. The summit and the temples together take most of a day. The pilgrim stairs are the walk up if you skip a cable.

On the summit a copper Phật Bà stands 72 m and weighs 170 tons, and a sandstone Di Lặc is 36 m high and 45 m wide, built of 6,688 blocks. Ba Den is called nóc nhà Nam Bộ. Núi Heo is 335 m and núi Phụng is 660 m. The tourist complex is given as about 24 km². The 1986 landscape reserve covers nearly 2,000 ha. The mountain was recognized on 21 January 1989. A logistics unit here is numbered 82 and 32. Liên đội 7 is named in both.

Weather can stop the cable. After 17:00 the cable fares drop through 31 December 2026. The buffet runs 10:00–15:00, so an evening ride is past that meal. The 18–26 June 2026 festival fares are a closed window. The caves on this mountain, including Động Kim Quang, belong to this visit. Cu Chi is its own day.

figures.caption: The summit statue and the lit terraces above the plain
figures.alt: The illuminated Ba Den summit statue above a cloud layer at dusk

gettingThere: The gate is at Núi Bà Đen, khu phố Ninh Phú, phường Bình Minh. The city tourism card puts the mountain a little more than 10 km from the city centre, and also prints the old line xã Thạnh Tân. Another account puts it 11 km northeast of the old town. From 1 July 2025 old Thạnh Tân and old Ninh Sơn sit inside phường Bình Minh. About 110 km northwest of Ho Chi Minh City is the distance measured to the mountain. From Tân Sơn Nhất a first stop here can exceed 110 km.

legs.heading: From Tân Ninh
legs.body: A little more than 10 km from the city centre, or 11 km northeast of the old town, to the gate in phường Bình Minh. Sleep nearer the gate if you want the first cabin.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: About 110 km northwest to the mountain. From Tân Sơn Nhất the road can exceed 110 km when the mountain is the first stop, about 2.5 to 3 hours by car, along Cộng Hòa and Quốc lộ 22 through Trảng Bàng and Gò Dầu.

hours: Monday to Friday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang 06:00–20:30, spiritual area 06:30–20:00. Saturday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang 05:30–21:00, Tâm An 06:30–19:00, spiritual area 06:00–20:30. Sunday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang 05:30–20:30, Tâm An 06:30–19:00, spiritual area 06:00–20:00. The gate opens one hour before the cable and closes one hour after.
closed: Tâm An does not run Monday to Friday. Weather can stop the cable.
admissionNote: Through 31 December 2026 an adult gate ticket is 10,000 VND and a child gate ticket is 5,000 VND. Under 1 m is free. From 1 m to under 1.4 m is the child fare. From 1.4 m is the adult fare. Vân Sơn is 450,000 VND for an adult and 350,000 VND for a child. Chùa Hang round trip is 250,000 VND and 150,000 VND, and one way is 150,000 VND and 100,000 VND. Tâm An is 450,000 VND and 350,000 VND. After 17:00, Vân Sơn is 300,000 VND and 200,000 VND, Chùa Hang round trip is 150,000 VND and 100,000 VND, and Tâm An is 300,000 VND and 200,000 VND. The buffet is 300,000 VND and 200,000 VND. Students with a valid card, Tây Ninh residents with papers, monks with church papers, and visitors 80 and older with an identity card have their own fares. Monks and visitors 80 and older ride free. Combo tickets cost more. The 18–26 June 2026 festival fares are closed.
